items.title: Desktop composer has one visual boundary
items.precondition: Isolated authenticated app runtime with an existing conversation at a viewport wider than 640px.
steps: Inspect the composer before and after focusing the textarea.
Type a message and send it.
items.expected: The form and inner composer track have no redundant divider, border, elevated-card chrome, or filled Send card; the desktop textarea has a soft rounded composer pill; idle desktop controls use a compact 32px row; and send/focus behavior works.
items.evidence: Frontend typecheck and production build passed; user confirmed manual acceptance of the listed desktop steps on 2026-08-21.
items.notes: Validate the screenshot-reported desktop issue directly.

items.title: Messenger-style mobile composer
items.precondition: Same isolated runtime, emulated at 390 CSS pixels wide or a comparable phone viewport.
steps: Open the conversation and inspect the footer.
Confirm the self avatar and outer separator are absent.
Use image attach and emoji insertion, then type a multi-line message and send it.
items.expected: Attachment and emoji controls sit beside one soft rounded input pill, Send remains reachable at the trailing edge, no controls clip when the textarea grows, and the existing behaviors work.
items.evidence: Frontend typecheck and production build passed; user confirmed manual acceptance of the listed mobile steps on 2026-08-21.
items.notes: Test with the software keyboard open when device tooling permits.

items.title: Composer states and chat-theme contrast
items.precondition: Same isolated runtime with a dark setting and a conversation using an active custom chat theme.
steps: Open the themed conversation at desktop and mobile widths.
Enter reply mode, then edit mode.
Inspect placeholder, controls, reply/edit preview, and disabled Send state.
items.expected: The themed conversation canvas continues through the footer with no separate tint or duplicate border, and reply/edit controls retain their existing behavior and accessible actions.
items.evidence: Frontend typecheck and production build passed; user confirmed manual acceptance of the listed theme and state checks on 2026-08-21.
